<!--
STOP. These are rejected by default. Proposing one is fine, but you need to
argue against the reasoning in CONTRIBUTING.md, not just ask:

  cloud/S3/remote sync · encryption · scheduling or a daemon · UI auth or TLS
  React/Vue/npm/any build step · Kubernetes/Swarm/Podman · CRIU live checkpoint
  telemetry or update checks · plugin/extension APIs

Docker Rewind snapshots a Compose stack and restores it. That's the whole
product, on purpose.
-->

**What are you trying to do?**
<!-- The underlying goal, not the feature you've already designed. -->

**What happens today?**
<!-- Including workarounds you've tried. -->

**Why does this belong in Rewind rather than another tool?**
<!-- rclone, restic, cron, and your filesystem cover a lot of ground already. -->

**Does it break any hard rule?**
<!-- Zero dependencies · no outbound network · no build step · never silently
     skip data · snapshots restorable with plain tar. Say so honestly if it does. -->

**Would you implement it?**
<!-- No is a fine answer. It just affects how it gets prioritised. -->
